text: How can it be mounted under it? its not on the same route? or is it?
resolution: Clarified the route composition: /compiled is its own Route, but hmsc-int renders route surfaces as siblings inside a persistent shell body after the editor QuadSplit. The editor panes are intentionally kept mounted once visited, and the code comment says route surfaces live inside the shell body while the editor stays mounted underneath. No code changes were made.
